edited_entry.title: BLE Vitals Spoofing via MITM

existing_controls.description: No cryptographic signatures or CRC validation for BLE notifications; relies on 'Just Works' BLE trust model

edited_entry.residual_risk_reason: Implementing BLE LE Secure Connections will mitigate spoofing but not eliminate all risks.

proposed_controls.description: Implement BLE LE Secure Connections with cryptographic signatures for message authentication.

proposed_doc_changes.body: The system shall use BLE LE Secure Connections to ensure the authenticity and integrity of BLE notifications.

edited_entry.narrative: REVIEWED: escalated to P0 by senior cybersecurity engineer.
